name: CollectSharePointArtifacts
purpose: Read-only discovery and evidence collection for a single project audit.
implementation_constraints: Use organizational authentication and a read-only SharePoint connection.
Do not modify, upload, move, or delete any SharePoint content.
Enumerate folders and files with pagination and support repositories up to 5,000 artifacts.
Return explicit access, pagination, and extraction errors; do not represent failures as successful empty results.
Return source URLs and paths for every evidence item so findings remain auditable.
Extract or retrieve sufficient document content for checklist evaluation; file names alone are not evidence.

Classify relevant artifacts where possible, including Test Strategy, Test Plan, Test Summary, Sign-off Documents, QAgile Reports, Jira/ALM Screenshots, CTD Evidence, IQPP Evidence, Defect Reports, TRR Documents, NFT Assessment Documents, Meeting Minutes, and Lessons Learned Documents.
Keep action responses within Copilot Studio limits. If content must be processed in batches, expose batch completion and coverage in the response.
